reason: Not measurable headlessly. Antigravity is an Electron IDE (package antigravity 2.24.0-1): its 'antigravity' entry point starts the GUI application (observed: 'Starting app (v2.24.0)', no exit, no prompt/print mode) and its agent runs inside the IDE through a bundled language_server that needs a Google OAuth login and speaks Google's Cloud Code (ccpa) protocol; the language_server has endpoint flags (--cloud_code_endpoint, --inference_api_server_url, --model_api_client_type=ccpa|gemini, --headless), but it is started and fed by the IDE's extension host; running a session without the GUI would need a Google login or GUI automation, both outside the rules of this measurement (no vendor login, no editing real agent config).
